journey: new campaign -> naturally resolve each age-gated story chapter and the Future conclusion -> build four income sites, Armory and Barracks -> forge/equip one legal age weapon and recruit one current-age formation in each of eight ages -> inspect Hero/Army -> pay each age gate -> capture Kingdom/Army/Adventure -> save/reload Future -> build Siege Workshop -> buy and field four age-appropriate tower families -> survive Endless -> claim Q6 exactly once
note: All construction, age advancement, map entry, and save actions use visible game controls. Playwright fast-forwards only idle elapsed time to verify legal production and construction; no campaign state or resources are injected. Adventure is entered in Stone and its age-specific visible terrain is captured at every legal age transition.

storyChapters.title: Chapter I — The First Fire
storyChapters.narrative:
Chapter I — The First Fire. Your people huddle in a cave mouth while something wet and heavy moves in the dark outside. You have flint, forty spears, and a name people will follow.

The fire is small. It will not last both the night and the strangers at the treeline.

storyChapters.title: Chapter II — Metal and Debt
storyChapters.narrative: Chapter II — Metal and Debt. The smelters work day and night. A trader from downriver offers a shipment on credit, with terms you cannot read.

storyChapters.title: Chapter III — The Iron Road
storyChapters.narrative: Chapter III — The Iron Road. Iron changes what a border means. Scouts return with maps of three valleys and the names of the warlords who hold them.

storyChapters.title: Chapter IV — The Divided Gate
storyChapters.narrative: Chapter IV — The Divided Gate. Varek Iron-Eye: “You arrive late, Arn. The High Council demands fealty, not hesitation.”

storyChapters.title: Chapter V — Powder and Consequence
storyChapters.narrative: Chapter V — Powder and Consequence. A monk brings you a jar of black grain that turns stone into gravel. Walls that took a century to raise now have a countdown on them.

storyChapters.title: Chapter VI — Smoke Over the Valley
storyChapters.narrative: Chapter VI — Smoke Over the Valley. Rail and furnace. Your realm fields in a week what once took a season.

storyChapters.title: Chapter VII — The Modern Crown
storyChapters.narrative: Chapter VII — The Modern Crown. Satellites, not scouts. Your hero — once a spear-carrier at a cave mouth — commands from a screen. One banner on the map is still not yours.
